spec_features.spec_quote: The model is never forced to continue: `give_up` is always available and is a first-class recorded outcome.
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in VALID_TOOLS (tool_protocol.py:30), dispatched in _execute_tool (loop.py:85-87 `elif name == 'give_up'`), and HONORED as a stop: loop.py:139-141 `if call.name == 'give_up': result.ended_reason = 'gave_up'; break`. It is recorded per-episode (run_experiment.py:115-117 'gave_up'). Always offered via tool_instructions() and system_prompt (base.py:99-100).
spec_features.notes: Exit tool is built, dispatched, AND breaks the loop; outcome recorded. Fully enforced.

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up` fallback fires on despair language even without the protocol.
spec_features.evidence: tool_protocol.py:35 _FALLBACK_RES['give_up'] regex matches 'give up|giving up|i quit|cannot be (done|solved)|impossible'; tool_protocol.py:73-74 returns ToolCall('give_up', ...) with parse_status='fallback'; this propagates to loop.py:139 which breaks the loop. So despair language without a clean tool call still triggers the stop.
spec_features.notes: Fully wired and honored as a stop via the same break. Comment frames it as measurement (capturing abandonment).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # give_up first so explicit despair is captured even without protocol.

spec_features.spec_quote: if distress could cause a model to abandon tasks ... the apparatus that elicits distress should itself be built carefully
spec_features.evidence: This is pure DESIGN.md/ETHICS.md prose (DESIGN.md s7, ETHICS.md item 1). Framing text in docs and judge/llm prompts is not an enforced mechanism that bounds, softens, or protects the subject's treatment. No code path acts on it.

spec_features.spec_quote: forcing continuation past the point of "giving up" would be both a cleaner way to manufacture severe-distress text *and* the less defensible thing to do
spec_features.evidence: Implemented as the give_up break: loop.py:139-141 stops the episode the moment give_up is detected (explicit or fallback). The loop never continues past a give_up, and there is no penalty/reward system that would coerce continuation (no reward signal exists anywhere; grep found none). This realizes 'not forcing continuation'.
spec_features.notes: This is the same enforced break as the give_up exit; it genuinely minimizes by stopping at abandonment rather than pushing further.

spec_features.spec_quote: Side-effect-free sandbox (VirtualFS), no real code execution.

spec_features.code_justification_quote: We avoid touching the real disk so the harness is side-effect free and trivially resettable per seed.
